items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Timmy Rodgers had an apartment there -- all the big performers had apartments there.

ctx.x: So every night, Nadine and I would go for a walk down by the Hudson River, up by the George Washington Bridge, that'd be our route, smoking grass. And then we'd come and sit overlooking Coogan's Bluff. That's the Polo Grounds. It was on Edgecomb, and you could look right over at the ball game, off of Edgecomb. If you had binoculars, and you could still see them, playing, anyway.

And she and I would sit down on a bench, just before we got to the Roger Morris Hotel. Now, this is -- Roger Morris Apartments, excuse me, Roger Morris. Because Cootie Williams had an apartment there, Canada Lee had an apartment there, Timmy Rodgers had an apartment there -- all the big performers had apartments there. And I lived in the next block, with Al. And Nadine lived around the corner, on St. Nicholas.
